Write text for the actual A4 overlay layout: default lettering is 35 pt and may reduce to a documented 18 pt minimum. Each panel prefers an upper pocket at most 35 percent of the panel tall, and a caption may also sit on a panel corner. Keep each speech turn to at most 12 words, use at most two turns, and keep the single narration caption to at most 14 words. Begin every speech turn with the speaking character's exact name from the characters list and a colon, for example `Nia: Follow my light!`; the name is removed before lettering and used to point the tail at that speaker. Narration has no speaker. Shorten with care to preserve the story's essential event and intent; never omit an event or silently truncate text. The shaped-text fit check rejects a panel if its text cannot fit the actual A4 reserved zone at or above 18 pt. Do not narrate visible action or describe the picture.
